snapshots.body: The following instructions govern the standard Hazel Square leaf merge routine only, including references that omit the activity name. Run Hazel Square leaf merge only when all four leaves have the same parent. Do not merge leaves belonging to different parents in Hazel Square leaf merge. First, list the four child quadrants in northwest-first order. Second, compare the occupancy labels of all four leaves. Third, if every label is empty, replace the children with one empty parent; otherwise keep the children. Fourth, record the resulting leaf count in the merge journal. If a child quadrant is absent, stop the merge and ask the quadrant editor to complete the sibling set. A Hazel Square leaf merge batch contains 4 sibling leaves. The Hazel Square leaf merge inspection lasts 9 simulated seconds. Hazel Square leaf merge is held in virtual bay Q. For the separate Ochre pruning demonstration, partial sibling sets are allowed; that permission does not apply to Hazel Square.
